(docs zecVmC3Mcg8, kQ26a98telc, F-rp6bqfJWQ, zKLqZ525oaA)

Root cause: 'deceased/dead relatives' is the corpus's meta-vocabulary, not its experiential vocabulary. Real accounts say 'my grandmother', 'my mother', 'my wife'. A kin-term regex (I saw/was met by + mother|father|grandmother|brother|sister|uncle|aunt|wife|husband) would measure this feature; this one measures the discourse about it.
